name: Plain Reader
description: Teaches the brain to explain a contract, lease, bill, medical bill, explanation of benefits, official letter or terms of service in plain words: what it asks of you, dates, money, one-sided terms and questions to ask, each point quoting the document, with a fixed line that it is not legal, medical or financial advice. It adds no tools of its own and fetches nothing.
author: Cypher Sisters
consent: This skill is text the brain reads. It runs nothing and uses no internet.
